data.one_liner: Fast and error-resilient pure-Dart codecs for binary, octal, hex, base32, base64, UTF-8, and PHC strings.
data.what_it_does: Provides a pure-Dart library of fast, error-resilient codecs supporting Base-2, Base-8, Base-16, Base-32, Base-64, BigInt, UTF-8, and the PHC/Modular Crypt Format. It features zero dependencies, zero native code or FFI, and works across all platforms including the web and Flutter.
use_when: You need to encode or decode binary data to various text bases (Base16, Base32, Base64, etc.) without external dependencies.
You are building or using cryptographic libraries that require constant-time byte comparisons and rendering digests as text.
You need to parse or build PHC/Modular Crypt Format strings.
avoid_when: You only need standard JSON serialization or basic UTF-8 string conversions already built into dart:convert.
strengths: Zero runtime dependencies and runs on every platform (VM, Flutter, Web).
Comprehensive alphabet variants (RFC 4648, crockford, geohash, z-base-32, URL-safe, etc.).
Includes non-throwing decoders and constant-time byte comparison.
weaknesses: Scope is strictly limited to encoding, decoding, and parsing specific text formats.
Does not handle high-level cryptographic primitives on its own (relies on partner libraries like hashlib).
